name: River level stations
status: Connected product · nationwide response; observation timezone unknown
cadence: Every 2 hours · 01:43/03:43/.../23:43 ICT target; execution may be delayed
description: Unfiltered public automatic river-level station response, mapped to canonical Thai provinces and districts. National default with ordinary area filters. Source wall times and m/MSL units remain separate; observation UTC and age are unknown. Neutral map markers do not represent risk. Manual rows without level values and non-Thai province codes are counted separately. Rain gauges are not connected.
attribution: HII / ThaiWater and original measuring agencies
authentication: One credential-free GET to the public portal endpoint succeeded on 2026-10-29; no embedded website credentials used
license: Reviewed monthly archive catalog: Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial; live product terms unverified
commercial_permission: Monthly archive catalog is non-commercial; live product unverified
redistribution_permission: Public portal values displayed with HII / ThaiWater attribution for this personal non-commercial project; live-product reuse terms are not represented as an unrestricted license.
request_quota: No numeric quota published in reviewed sources. One bounded public GET per two-hour ETL; history is fetched only for a selected published station, with a 15-minute cache.
spatial_coverage: All canonical Thai station rows in each unfiltered response. Not a certified complete national station inventory; missing stations or provinces remain unavailable.
spatial_resolution: Station point with canonical provider administrative codes where recognized; administrative filtering does not imply area-wide water conditions
temporal_resolution: Original minute timestamps without timezone; station ages differ. No observation UTC time is inferred.
units_crs: waterlevel_msl: meters above mean sea level (ม.รทก.); waterlevel_m: meters as reported, separate datum unverified. Provider geographic station coordinates are range-checked; measurement calibration is not certified.
latency: Query freshness is tracked separately. Source observation timestamps omit timezone; observation UTC and actual age remain unknown.
fallback: Retain the last complete validated national A/B generation on refresh failure; no synthetic or discharge-as-level fallback.

name: Observed rain stations
status: Connected product · unfiltered national rain station response
cadence: Every 2 hours with the HII station workflow; scheduler can be delayed
description: Source-reported rain_24h and rain_1h at automatic stations from the unfiltered ThaiWater public portal response. Province/district/basin filtering follows explicit provenance. Original observation wall times omit timezone; observation UTC and accumulation-window instants remain null. Zero and missing values remain distinct. Station values are not area-average rainfall.
attribution: HII / ThaiWater and original measuring agencies
authentication: Credential-free official public portal endpoint; no embedded website keys used
license: Public portal access verified; no live-product reuse licence documented in the reviewed endpoint
commercial_permission: Personal/non-commercial project scope; no commercial reuse entitlement asserted
redistribution_permission: Retain HII / ThaiWater and measuring-agency attribution; no unrestricted live-data licence or agency endorsement claimed
request_quota: No documented numeric integration quota. One bounded rain response GET every two hours, independent of the water-level response.
spatial_coverage: All canonical Thai province rows in each unfiltered public rain response. Counts can change; no permanent station allowlist.
spatial_resolution: Station points. District mapping uses exact unique Thai district name within the supplied province. Basin matching uses conservative interior points in DDPM 22-basin boundaries; near-border points stay unassigned.
temporal_resolution: rain_24h and rain_1h fields with minute wall timestamps lacking timezone; exact UTC accumulation bounds unknown
units_crs: mm / 24h and mm / 1h as reported, separate from forecast rain. Provider timestamps omit timezone; exact UTC window start/end are not inferred.
latency: Query freshness is tracked separately. Source observation timestamps omit timezone; observation UTC and actual age remain unknown.
fallback: Independent last complete validated A/B rain generation. Missing values remain null; no model or discharge substitution.
